title: Add DoseLog entity
description: Room entity recording a single logged dose event: who, what, when, and how much, plus the computed next-eligible time. Every dose log is an additive history event -- no compare-and-set guard is needed on insert, unlike a mutable completion flag, because two caregivers logging close together is exactly the scenario the app's warning dialog exists to surface, not a race to resolve.
acceptance_criteria: @Entity(tableName = "dose_logs") data class DoseLog with an autoGenerate Int primary key id

Fields: profileId: Int, medicationId: Int, givenAtEpochMillis: Long, doseAmount: String, nextEligibleAtEpochMillis: Long? = null, wasOverrideWarningAcknowledged: Boolean = false, createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
profileId and medicationId are plain Int linking columns with no @ForeignKey annotation
